events.title: Summer Movies in the Park | Space Jam
events.description: Michael Jordan makes his starring film debut opposite the celluloid skills of Warner Bros.' Looney Tunes.Prospect Park Alliance, Fort Greene Park Conservancy, and Rooftop Films announce Summer Movies in the Park, presented by NewYork-Presbyterian. This free, outdoor movie series in Prospect Park and Fort Greene Park takes place on Wednesday nights this summer, with screenings on August 5th and August 12th in Prospect Park, and August 26th and September 9th in Fort Greene Park. August 26: Space Jam (PG) - 30th Anniversary Screening6:00 PM: Lawn Opens8:30 PM: Film BeginsDirections: Fort Greene Park, Central Lawn at Washington Park and Dekalb Avenue EntranceSpace Jam (PG) – 30th Anniversary ScreeningJoe Pytka | 1996 | US | 87 minsThis iconic live-action movie features NBA superstar Michael Jordan, who is recruited by Bugs Bunny and the Looney Tunes, the Tune Squad, for a high-stakes game against an evil theme park owner and his minions, the Monstars, in outer space. The films will begin shortly after sundown; come early to picnic and enjoy pre-movie entertainment. Please note that the movie may be cancelled in the case of inclement weather. Attendees will be notified via Eventbrite and the Prospect Park and Fort Greene Park social media channels.This series is presented through support of NewYork-Presbyterian.

events.title: Summer on the Hudson: Art in the Park
events.description: Art in the Park invites children ages 3-8 to learn about their local environment through a mix of arts & crafts activities. This hands-on, place-based curriculum builds kids' appreciation for the plants, pollinators, and wildlife found in Riverside Park, and fosters their creativity. Mondays and Thursdays at Riverbank (Camel) Playground; Tuesdays and Wednesdays at Hippo Playground. Art in the Park is fully funded by proceeds from the Hippo Playground Spring Fair.

events.title: Summer on the Hudson: Ballroom Basix
events.description: Join Summer on the Hudson and Ballroom Basix USA  for fitness, fun, and fancy footwork! Ballroom Basix provides physical, social, emotional and multicultural engagement through the etiquette and education of non-competitive Ballroom & Latin partner dancing. This class energizes, entertains and educates teachers, students, their families & communities while emphasizing the poise & politeness our program promotes, true to our meaningful motto: "Making manners matter...every move we make!"About Ballroom Basix: The BBX syllabus and methodology creatively contribute to the health and wellness of the diverse schoolchildren whom we serve by getting classmates hand-in-hand, arm-in-arm and eye-to-eye. The partner dancing experience is enhanced by the verbal & physical courtesy and consent inherent to partner dancing as students dance — rotationally & respectfully — with one another.About the teaching artist: Marisa Caputo is a recent graduate of NYU Tisch School of the Arts where , in addition to her bachelors degree studies, she was active in NYU's Latin & Ballroom Dance Team. She trained in partner dancing for multiple years of through the Fred Astaire Dance Studios, where she has also taught part time. She has been a valued Teaching Artist with BALLROOM BASIX for almost 4 years — and is thrilled to share her love of Ballroom & Latin dance with children, young adults, and seniors throughout New York City. Marisa continues to train and compete in all four ballroom styles—Latin, Rhythm, Standard, and Smooth—and is passionate about creating a fun, welcoming environment for dancers of all ages and experience levels. She is very excited to be teaching this summer at Riverside Park!

Our knowledgeable NYC Parks staff train kids in sports such as basketball, ball hockey, kickball, flag football, pickleball, soccer, team handball, track and field, and volleyball. This program covers basic and more advanced techniques.  Summer Sports Experience is a drop-in program recommended for children ages 8-14. Participants can stop by for one or more sessions, but kids who stay for the whole program will get the most benefit from it. events.title: Team RIVER Volunteers
events.description: Volunteer with Team RIVER (Randall’s Island Volunteer Ecological Restorers) and help keep Randall’s Island Park beautiful! Team RIVER Volunteers regularly work with the Natural Areas team twice a month to take care of and restore our natural spaces on the island. With our Horticulture team, volunteers care for the many gardens, green streets and meadows, every second Wednesday of each month. Team RIVER also works with our Sports Field and Operations teams, keeping our park clean and maintained. If you are only able to volunteer on a limited basis, you are still very much welcome!This volunteer opportunity is open to individuals from the community. Groups of more than 5 people must contact: Volunteers@RandallsIsland.orgVolunteers must be at least 11 years old. Anyone under the age of 18 must have a waiver signed by their legal guardian before starting any work. Children under 16 must also have an adult with them while volunteering. A downloadable volunteer waiver can be found at this link: General Volunteer – Randall’s IslandRegistration is required here.Location: Volunteers will be notified after registration.For inquiries about accessibility, to request an accommodation, or for event information, please email publicprograms@randallsisland.org.

events.title: Wetland Wednesdays: Volunteer Restoration at Van Cortlandt Park
events.description: Join Van Cortlandt Park Alliance for hands-on wetland and floodplain restoration. Dates include Wednesdays weekly from August 5th - August 26th. Dates are 8/5, 8/12, 8/19, and 8/26. All sessions run 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM.August 5 and August 12: hand removal of invasive water chestnut on Van Cortlandt Lake, from shore and from boats. August 19 and August 26: cutting invasive common reed (Phragmites) and clearing the floodplain edge. Wear clothes that can get wet and muddy; long sleeves and boots recommended for the August 19 and 26 sessions.Meet outside the VCPA offices at the Van Cortlandt Golf House, next to the bathrooms. Tools, gloves and training provided. No experience needed. Ages 15+ (minors need a signed waiver). Limited to 30 volunteers per session. Registration required. Groups of 6 or more, please email noel@vancortlandt.org in advance.
